aiSkill.hint: One plugin installs all {count} Shiny skills. Your agent loads only the skill relevant to what you're building, so there's no cost to having them all available.
androidForegroundService.message: Android uses a foreground service!  You must have an application icon set or a drawable resource called notification in order for this background operation to work
behindShiny.ask: Need help integrating Shiny, or consulting support?
behindShiny.bio: A software engineer with 25+ years specializing in .NET architecture across cloud, mobile, desktop and web. Building cross-platform .NET libraries since the early Xamarin days — those packages have now been downloaded over 40 million times on NuGet.
behindShiny.channelCopy: .NET deep dives, library walkthroughs and community discussions — the two of them working through the same problems these libraries were built to solve.
homeHero.headlineLine1: The hard parts of your app,
homeHero.lede: Everything the platform makes hard: Bluetooth, background jobs, push, location, a document database, speech and AI, an HTTP server that runs inside your MAUI app, 75+ UI controls, and plenty more. Forty-plus libraries that own the platform code, the permissions and the background execution — so your time goes to the app your users actually asked for.

supportChannels.commercialBody: Shiny is maintained in the open. Sponsorship funds that work; ShinySoft Technologies handles consulting, private support, and anything that cannot be discussed in public.
supportChannels.commercialExpect: Sponsors are prioritised. For commercial enquiries, see ShinySoft.
supportChannels.discordBody: Shiny lives in the MAUIverse Discord alongside the wider .NET MAUI community — good for a fast sanity check, sharing what you are building, or a conversation that would be slow over issues.
supportChannels.discordExpect: Casual and realtime. Chat scrolls away, so anything worth keeping belongs in Discussions or an issue.
supportChannels.discussionsBody: The org-wide forum, shared by every Shiny library. Best for anything that spans more than one repo, or where you are not yet sure whether you have found a bug.
supportChannels.discussionsExpect: Answered by maintainers and other users. No response time guarantee.
supportChannels.discussionsUse: Questions, design feedback, and "which library should I use?"
supportChannels.issuesBody: Each library has its own repo, so an issue needs to land in the right one. The picker below maps what you are using to where it lives.
supportChannels.issuesExpect: A repro (or a failing sample) is what turns a report into a fix.
supportChannels.issuesUse: Bugs, crashes, and concrete feature requests
testimonials.ctaBody: We'd love to hear about it. Share your story and have your company logo featured here — it shows the rest of the community what's possible with Shiny.NET.

testimonials.poolmathWhat: Pool care for hundreds of thousands of pool owners
testimonials.speedydockWhat: Boat launch scheduling for drystack marinas — iOS, Android and web since 2016
themeComposer.note: Everything on the canvas is a real Shiny control. Change a knob and it re-skins live, then take the CSS or the XAML with you.
